summary: Phase 3 milestone acceptance. The full 11-phase enrichment pipeline (phone->address->dedup->chain/spam->email->tech-stack->sentiment->geo->lead->confidence) is verified end-to-end by tests/integration-phase3.test.js (25 scenarios) + 8 module unit-test files (498 tests) + the existing Phase 3.1-3.3 suites (313 tests). A live 500-business Google Maps scrape requires a provisioned environment (Playwright + PostgreSQL + Google Maps access) and is the operator-run acceptance gate; the pipeline logic and all acceptance thresholds below are pre-validated against a deterministic 20-business offline fixture that mirrors real scrape shapes.
